title: CHGR shared limitations definitions
description: Bounded free-text limitations array for the CHGR schema family (Phase 143E). Limitations are disclosures only and never alter authority or lifecycle outcome (CHGR-REQ-097, CHGR-REQ-125). Independently defined from src/pcae/schema_resources/cltr_cutover/shared/limitations.schema.json per CHGR-001 Sec.16/Sec.19.1's no-composition-across-families rule.

allOf.description: Forbids every C0/C1 control character except tab (\t) and newline (\n).
At most 8 newline characters per entry.

limitation_entry.description: A single free-text limitation string. Non-empty, at most 2000 characters, at most 8 newlines, no control characters other than tab/newline. Rejected outright at the bound (never silently truncated).

limitations_array.description: The limitations array present on every CHGR artifact type. An empty array is permitted (no limitations to disclose).
